name: CAMELYON17 Cancer Detection Challenge
description: CAMELYON17 is a histopathology benchmark for detecting lymph node metastases in whole-slide images, originally centered on breast cancer screening and metastasis identification.
evaluation_method: AUC and slide/patient-level detection metrics, often with sensitivity at specified false-positive rates depending on challenge protocol
notes: Challenge data and evaluation are commonly used for weakly supervised pathology and detection research; protocols may vary by subtask.
